task.title: Merge Duplicates
task.shortdesc: Resolve duplicate items by merging them.

taskbody.context: Merges will retain all of the collections and tags of the merged items; deleting one item will lose these data. Merges are also automatically recognized by the word processor plugins and don't affect your automatically generated citations and bibliographies.

step.cmd: To merge items in the Duplicate Items collection, select an item in the center pane.
step.stepresult: Zotero will automatically co-select the other items that it thinks are duplicates.

step.cmd: Click the Merge <number> Items button in the right pane to merge the items.
step.note: If the item fields don't match completely, you can select one item to be the “master” from the list at the top of the right pane, then select alternative versions of mismatched fields using the icons to the right of each field.

chrow.choption: Select a single item in the Duplicate Items view
De-select an item from a set of duplicates
chrow.chdesc: Hold down Ctrl (Windows/Linux) or Cmd (Mac) while clicking.

chrow.choption: Select a group of two or more items of the same type anywhere in your Zotero library
chrow.chdesc: Right-click, select Merge Items... from the context menu.
